title: Titan Silhouette of the False Dawn
description: Aten Ra advances through tiered sun platforms with simultaneous anchor points and overcharge hazards while the Gate tests whether solar law can hold under pressure.
lore: This mission shows the Sun Realm refusing panic: law, river, and battle line answer the Gate wound without rewriting established Canon.
terrain: tiered sun platforms with simultaneous anchor points and overcharge hazards

objectives.primary: Complete two battlefield stages under changing solar hazards.
optional: Keep all one active Titan standing
Trigger at least two faction synergy actions

boss.mechanic: changes sunflare timing and objective pressure

specialRules: Overcharge Law: standing on empowered tiles grants attack reach but increases incoming pressure.
Split Threat: two objectives resolve on opposite sides of the field.
victoryConditions: Complete two battlefield stages under changing solar hazards.

stars.one: Primary completed with the active Titan standing under severe turn pressure

activeTitanDesignNotes: Balanced for the standard one active Titan; nonstandard modes require explicit Creator approval.

tacticalProfile.rule: Recommended advantages only — any valid active Titan can attempt the mission.

activeTitanPolicy.rosterPurpose: Choose the best single Titan before launch; roster depth changes approach, not on-field body count.
